criteria.requirement: Repair expo for finite positive increasing bases/factors with a finite positive max_value so an intermediate exponentiation overflow does not terminate the sequence. Compute the true capped result, including cases where base**n overflows but factor*base**n is still below the cap. Preserve exact ordinary float outputs, priming, stable saturation, zero-factor and decreasing-base behavior. Unbounded and unsupported-domain overflow must remain explicit; do not blindly turn every OverflowError into max_value.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
